instruction: Power OFF. Unplug the adapter. Set the meter to continuity (beep). Probe pin 1 of the J1 plug and pin 1 of the LOAD1 terminal (both labelled in AR). Expect a beep.
reason: The close-up shows a gap at the J1 plug; one continuity check proves or clears it before anything is replaced.
safety_notes: Unplug the power adapter before probing.
Do not rely on wire colour to identify polarity; the AR labels mark the exact pins.
